newsitem.title: USA: Food Lion starts $26 per share Kash n' Karry tender.
newsitem.headline: Food Lion starts $26 per share Kash n' Karry tender.

text.p: Food Lion Inc., one of the nation's 10 largest supermarket chains, Friday began its previously announced all-cash tender offer for all of the outstanding common shares of Kash n' Karry at $26.00 per share or $341 million.
The merger between the two supermarket chains is expected to be completed later this year or early next year.
Salisbury, N.C.-based Food Lion has more than 1,100 stores in 14 states.
Kash n' Karry, based in Tampa, Fla., has 100 food stores and other facilities in West Central Florida.
Food Lion's stock closed unchanged at $8.75, while Kash n' Karry edged up 1.5 cents to $25.77 on Nasdaq.
